heading: Service of process
lead: With respect to service of process, the corporation shall comply with the laws of—

tree.text: the jurisdiction under which the corporation is incorporated; and
those jurisdictions within the United States and its territories within which the corporation carries out activities in furtherance of the purposes of the corporation.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 118–31, div. E, title LI, § 5103(a), Dec. 22, 2023, 137 Stat. 937.)
